purpose: Correlate confirmed COLI0200 material IDs with the canonical per-contact surfaceMask path and modern DD-wheel output.

samplePolicy.recommended: emit on any surfaceMask/loadColiType/stage/roadSection change; optional <=10Hz heartbeat
samplePolicy.reason: Preserves transitions without per-frame log volume.

fields.name: surfaceMask
fields.semantic: four native contact surface masks; canonical EXE proves each mask is 1u << COLI0200 materialId

fields.name: materialId
fields.source: derived from one-hot surfaceMask[i] using countr_zero/bit-scan
fields.semantic: exact COLI0200 material byte for nonzero one-hot masks; canonical EXE VA 0x0043ECB8..0x0043ECC7

derived.name: materialTransition
derived.formula: surfaceMask[i] or materialId[i] changed since prior sample

wheelOrder.rule: Do not label FL/FR/RL/RR until canonical wheel-object ordering is separately proven.

interpretationRules: Canonical EXE proves surfaceMask = 1u << materialId for the selected collision record.
For a nonzero one-hot surfaceMask, derived materialId is exact and may be used for diagnostics.
Contact index ordering is not yet proven; keep names contact0..contact3.
Human labels for non-primary material IDs remain open until driven runtime correlation identifies the physical surface.
Keep DD-wheel feel parameters separate from original Xbox roughness values.
successCriteria: Repeated passes over the same physical region reproduce the same raw mask pattern.
Forward/reverse stages correlate to equivalent static collision attributes where geometry/material is shared.
A candidate COLI attribute predicts raw surfaceMask transitions across at least two distinct stages before receiving a semantic material name.

primaryKnown.0x14: special rough primary-road strip; mask 0x00100000; native roughness 0.71
primaryKnown.0x16: Casino Town primary-road family; mask 0x00400000; Casino exception roughness 0.25
primaryKnown.0x17: Snow/Ice primary road; mask 0x00800000; native roughness 0.50
